name: Keif Euphoria
body:
The calming effects of keif make you difficult to disturb.

Prerequisite(s): Sahir-Afiyun or keif addict.

Benefit(s): When you take a dose of keif, in addition to its normal initial effect, you gain a +2 bonus on saves against emotion and fear effects. Once per day, if you fail a saving throw against an emotion or fear effect while you are under the initial effect of keif, you can attempt another saving throw 1 round later at the same DC.
